rationale: Liu and Ednilson are both data scientists with hands-on experience applying data science in real-world settings—Liu at EneHealths and Ednilson at University of San Francisco. While Liu brings a complementary skill set in SQL, Python, and BI tools like Tableau and Power BI alongside business analysis expertise, Ednilson's focus on practical machine learning applications could offer a different perspective on data science methodology. They'd benefit from comparing approaches to turning data insights into business impact across their respective organizations.
intro_message: Liu Nils, meet Ednilson Chiambo — you're both data scientists applying your skills in production environments and could share useful perspectives on data-driven problem solving.
